g.title: G
g.text: Cardiovascular III: Angina, ACS & MI — Concept Map (NURS 419, Lecture 10/29/2026)
UA: no troponin, no ST↑ · NSTEMI: troponin, no ST↑ · STEMI: troponin + ST↑ → reperfuse · never nitrates + PDE-5 inhibitors

g.title: sd
g.text: Supply: coronary flow · diastolic time · O₂ content

g.title: stable
g.text: Fixed narrowing · exertion, stress, cold, meals
Predictable · relieved by rest / SL nitro

g.title: variant
g.text: Coronary vasospasm · at rest, early morning

g.title: nbc
g.text: Amlodipine ↓ afterload · verapamil/diltiazem slow the heart

g.title: safety
g.text: Non-DHP: bradycardia, AV block · DHP: edema

g.title: mi
g.text: Pressure at rest, radiating · dyspnea, sweat, nausea
Older adults, diabetes: minimal/no chest pain

g.title: reperf
g.text: Fibrinolytics if no timely PCI (bleeding risk)
